defaults.wall.education.questions.0.title: What does Premium include?
defaults.wall.education.questions.0.answer: Premium workouts, World Tours, complete Training Programs, Dynamic Plan activation, workout and weekly AI insights, member AI Coach allowance and eligible challenges. Access lasts while your membership is active.
defaults.wall.education.questions.1.title: Is AI Coach unlimited?
defaults.wall.education.questions.1.answer: Premium includes a conversation allowance. Your balance is shown in Membership & Usage. Extra Credits are available separately. Workouts, plan activation and AI insights do not use your chat allowance.
defaults.wall.education.questions.2.title: Can I turn off renewal?
defaults.wall.education.questions.2.answer: You can turn off auto-renewal in subscription settings. Your Premium access continues until the end of your current paid period.
